objective: Isolate why @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.8 dependency resolution stalls by comparing rc.7 and rc.8 registry metadata, tarball retrieval, and clean dependency installation without starting DSH or modifying dsh-vision product code.

Both rc.7 and rc.8 `npm view` metadata probes are attempted and reported with elapsed time, exit status, and bounded evidence.

Both rc.7 and rc.8 tarballs are attempted with `npm pack --ignore-scripts --json`; report elapsed time, success/failure, tarball filename/size/integrity when available, and remove temporary packed artifacts afterward.

Compare the top-level dependency metadata of rc.7 and rc.8 and summarize concrete added/removed/version-changed entries that may affect resolver complexity. Do not speculate beyond the observed metadata.
Run the two dependency-only installs in separate new temporary directories with no dsh-vision workspace influence, no scripts, no audit, and no funding lookup.
Each dependency-only install has a strict 180-second wall-clock limit. Report COMPLETE, FAIL, or TIMEOUT plus elapsed seconds for rc.7 and rc.8 independently.
If rc.8 alone times out, capture bounded npm timing/verbose evidence sufficient to identify the last resolver/network stage reached, without dumping secrets or huge logs.
Do not run the DSH CLI, do not run `dsh plugin`, do not create or mutate a DSH_HOME/profile, and do not call any paid or credentialed service.
Do not modify product source, tests, scripts, CI, package metadata, README, or docs/compatibility.md.

The Result Contract must distinguish whether the evidence points to registry/tarball access, dependency-graph resolution, install lifecycle scripts, or remains inconclusive; do not label dsh-vision runtime incompatible unless runtime was actually reached (it is not part of this task).
